role: The static facade over StringTranslate: translateToLocal and friends turn translation keys like 'container.inventory' into display strings.
notes: The native HUD and GUI screens draw hard-coded English strings (for example "Inventory" in csrc/engine/raster_hud.c:1590); no translation table exists. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Translates keys to display strings (item and entity names, achievement text, chat); no game state reads the result, and native draws the en_US strings it needs directly (raster_hud.c).
